inherited_words: all 16 binary words W of length 4
target_words: all 16 binary words V of length 4
task: implement F_(VV) for every initial state on the ring with one common open-loop program
old_task: implement F_(WW) for every initial state on the ring with one common open-loop program
capacity: one callable length-four macro; primitive A and B remain available to every arm
execution_cost: expanded physical ticks plus dispatch_cost times issued primitive or macro instructions
revise_cost: 0 to retain current word; otherwise min(8, 1 + 2 * Hamming(current, new))
trace_cost: revisable arm pays trace_reserve once before the change, even if unused
planning: Exact oracle chooses a library and the cheapest program for each declared task; no search cost, hidden dynamics, learned policy, or uncertainty about the current target is modeled.
enumeration: Enumerate all 511 primitive words of length 0..8; compare their full transformation arrays on all 2^n initial states. For every macro, find a minimum-dispatch encoding of each word, then the cheapest realization of each target transformation.
strata: literal shift: unchanged / one edit / two-or-more edits
inherited compilation paid off during prechange jobs
readouts: exact counts of each arm winning, tying, or losing against uncompiled, frozen, and replacement
semantic equality of old and new task transformations
witness_selection: First lexicographic (n,A,B,dispatch,trace,K,W,V) useful-inheritance witness at the primary parameters for revisable beating all other arms, revisable losing to frozen, and revisable losing to replacement. Save a further physical-only control; replay selected expanded programs independently.
checks: integer CA transitions match the vectorized engine at n=6
prefix and suffix constructions of every word map agree
minimum-dispatch encodings agree with independent macro-token enumeration
every returned encoded program expands to its declared word
dispatch-zero execution costs are identical across libraries
replacement never costs more than frozen (structural control)
free-trace revision never costs more than replacement (structural control)
selected programs implement the target for every finite-ring state through the separate vectorized engine
limits: All macros expand into existing operations: no new unbounded physical reachability is possible.
Costs are declared dimensionless resource prices, not measured energy or cognition.
An extra revision choice without a trace charge weakly dominates replacement by construction; that control is not evidence of adaptation.
No discovery of macros is modeled. All inherited constructions, including unhelpful ones, are retained in the complete record; successful prechange constructions form a declared stratum.
Full transformation equivalence is finite-ring and budget bounded; literal word distance need not match behavioral distance.
This tests one library transition under perfect current-task knowledge, not autonomous learning, viability, or ethical alignment.
